title: Tormach lathe post: the first rapid after G30 runs diagonally to the start point, and the closing G30 diagonally back

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found while working #1596 (the Tormach G30 review).

**What happens:** `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps` posts each tool change as `G30`, `T0101`, the spindle, then the section's first move straight to its start point, e.g. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/turning_mm.nc:7-11`:

```
G30
T0101
G97 S3000 M3
M8
G0 X14.2 Z-16.8
```

That `G0` runs diagonally from wherever the operator stored G30 to a point beside the stock surface. The program end does the reverse: `G30` diagonally from the last retract (`onClose`, `afterOp` "home"). With G30 stored inside the stock's envelope in X (for example on or near the centreline in front of the face, a plausible "safe" spot for drilling), the diagonal crosses the stock face or corner. It is the lathe twin of #1594 / #1596 (a stored G30 position deciding whether a rapid collides), but the mill's fix (`G53 G0 Z<safe>` straight up) has no lathe equivalent.

**Expected:** the approach after a tool change and the departure to G30 never depend on where G30 is stored: e.g. the first move goes X to the start diameter (or to the stock's clearance diameter) first, then Z, and the departure leaves in +X before G30; or the post states and pins a different order with the reason recorded.

**Rating:** P3 (wrong behaviour with a workaround: store G30 outside the stock's diameter and to the right of its face). Raise to P1 if a Hub or machine run shows the diagonal hitting the stock with a realistic G30.

**Done means:** the Tormach lathe's first rapid after a tool change and its move to G30 at the end follow a stated, pinned order that cannot cross the stock for any stored G30 outside the chuck; the Tormach lathe goldens are regenerated with only that change; the decision is in `docs/decisions/`.

Related: #1594, #1596.
